//: PHASE 109-C2.1 — build config for the parser sidecar artifact.
SEPARATE FROM tsconfig.json ON PURPOSE. The application config sets
noEmit:true, module:esnext and moduleResolution:bundler, because Next
bundles the app. None of that can produce a runnable sidecar: the parser is
a plain Node program that must run from CommonJS files inside a container
NO PATH ALIASES. tsc does not rewrite them on emit, so a compiled
require("@/lib/...") would fail at runtime. Every module reachable from the
sidecar imports relatively for that reason.
Emission is deterministic: no source maps, no declarations, LF newlines, so
two clean builds produce byte-identical artifacts.
